injuries.comment: Raynaud is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, per Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140.
The Kings reported Simmons is OUT for the 2026 - 2027 season due to an achilles iinjury.
Harris is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.
The Spurs reported on Monday (Oct. 19) that Quaintance is not yet been cleared for basketball activities, per Matt Guzman of SI.com.
The Spurs said on Thursday (Nov. 19) that Harper is expected to miss two to three weeks, per Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com.
